premises: Al doping in a Cr coating will form an Al-rich oxide layer at the Cr–Zr interface at high temperature.
This interfacial Al-rich oxide layer will act as a diffusion barrier to inhibit Cr–Zr interdiffusion.
The Al-rich oxide layer will be dense with low vacancy concentration, increasing activation energy for diffusion.
The Cr–Al coating will maintain equivalent corrosion resistance to pure Cr under normal PWR conditions.
Multi-element alloy barriers increase failure temperature against interdiffusion, supporting the barrier concept.
